biggest_catch: This pays in uChoose Rewards POINTS, not cash — and you cannot open the account online: you must visit a Hanmi Bank branch in person, then order, activate, and enroll your debit card in uChoose Rewards within 30 days, or you get nothing. The entry $250 tier still requires a $15,000 average daily balance for the first three full months, and points expire 3 years after crediting.
catches: Payout is in uChoose Rewards points, convertible at Hanmi's own stated value of $1 per 100 points (25,000 pts = $250; 100,000 pts = $1,000; 200,000 pts = $2,000) — points are not cash until you redeem them for cash back or gift cards at uchooserewards.com.

No online opening — the official page says 'Visit any Hanmi Bank branch to open a business checking account.' Hanmi's branch network is limited (deal sites list CA, IL, NJ, NY, TX, VA) — confirm you can reach a branch.
You must order, activate, AND enroll your debit card in uChoose Rewards within 30 days of account opening at uchooserewards.com — miss any step and the bonus is lost.
Maintain the tier's average daily balance for the first three FULL months: $15,000+ for $250, $50,000+ for $1,000, $100,000+ for $2,000. Parked cash has a real opportunity cost.
New business checking customers only — no existing Hanmi business checking relationship within the past 60 days; one eligible account per TIN.
Account must remain open and you must remain enrolled in uChoose Rewards on the payout date; points are credited within 30 days after the first three full months.
Activating the redeem function for a business uChoose Rewards account requires contacting the branch or call center (855-773-8778) and takes 1 business day.
Points expire 3 years from the month in which they were credited — don't sit on them.
Offer is subject to change and may be discontinued at any time without notice.
Like other bank bonuses, expect the bonus to be reported as taxable interest income (confirm at tax time).
